visual.name: bfusionKanbanBoard
visual.description: Vertical swim-lane Kanban board for project task management. Cards are grouped by State columns with optional assignee, dates, and progress indicators. Supports cross-filtering and responsive layout.

dataRoles.name: plan
dataRoles.description: Project or plan name that the task belongs to.

dataRoles.name: task
dataRoles.description: Task or work-item name shown on the Kanban card.

dataRoles.name: state
dataRoles.description: Current state/status of the task. Each unique value becomes a swim-lane column (e.g. To Do, In Progress, Done).

dataRoles.name: stateOrder
dataRoles.description: Optional numeric sort key to control the left-to-right order of swim-lane columns.

dataRoles.name: assignedTo
dataRoles.description: Optional. Person assigned to the task, shown on the card.

dataRoles.name: pctDone
dataRoles.description: Optional. Completion percentage (0-100 or 0-1). Displayed as a progress bar on the card.

dataRoles.name: priority
dataRoles.description: Optional. Task priority shown as a colored badge on the card.

dataRoles.name: storyPoints
dataRoles.description: Optional. Story-point estimate for the task. Shown as a colored circle on the card.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

showSummaryBar.description: Stacked bar at top showing card distribution across lanes.

showSearch.description: Search box to filter cards by task name, plan, or assignee.

showAssigneeFilter.description: Clickable avatar pills to filter by person.

compactMode.description: Show only task name and priority badge for denser view.

showKpiPanel.description: Left-side panel showing overall board KPIs (total tasks, overdue, avg progress, story points, priority breakdown).

showLaneAccentColor.description: Colored top-border on each lane header, auto-assigned per lane.

wipLimit.description: Max cards per lane. 0 = no limit. Exceeding turns header red.

groupByPlan.description: Group cards within each lane under collapsible Plan headers.

sortBy.description: Sort cards within each lane. Values: none, priority, dueDate, percentDone.

showOverdueBadge.description: Show a red OVERDUE tag on cards past their due date.

showDueCountdown.description: Show '3d left' or '2d overdue' instead of raw dates.

showStoryPoints.description: Show story-point value as a colored circle on the card.

showCardKpis.description: Show a compact KPI row at the bottom of each card (SP, days, %).

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
